description: Redshift path overrides (REDSHIFT_PATHOVERRIDE_FILE) that map the absolute paths baked into the scenes to the scenes folder. 'to' is relative to redshift_project_root. Redshift compares path prefixes case-insensitively and converts 'from' to backslashes, so absolute paths stored with forward slashes cannot be overridden (those scenes fall back to their relative paths). An entry with 'relative_to' builds 'from' from that scene folder plus the relative path stored in the scene. The first matching entry wins.

overrides.note: proxies loaded by gi_types/cornell-box-cube-* and bring_up-simplified_copied_yellow_light
